scripts.build: rm -rf public && mkdir public && cp -r ../index.html ../vendor ../icon.svg ../icon-192.png ../icon-512.png ../apple-touch-icon.png ../manifest.webmanifest public/
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --local --port 8787 --local-upstream localhost:8787 --var ORIGINS:http://localhost:8787 --var RP_ID:localhost
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply 99ms --remote && wrangler deploy
